description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Deribit Futures Curve data, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and asynchronous data fetching.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesCurveQueryParams
classes.description: Model for querying Deribit Futures Curve data with validation for symbol and hours_ago.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesCurveData
classes.description: Data model representing a single point in the Deribit Futures Curve, including expiration and price.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesCurveFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class to retrieve and process Deribit Futures Curve data based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a DeribitFuturesCurveQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw futures curve data from Deribit, handling multiple symbols and hours_ago adjustments.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into structured DeribitFuturesCurveData objects, sorting by expiration date.
